Products/Dynamic braking resistors

DBR for electric motors

Dynamic braking resistors

Dissipate the kinetic energy of braking loads in cranes, centrifuges and similar machines.

Request a Quote

Dynamic braking resistors are used for rheostatic braking of electric motors. The excess kinetic energy resulting from braking or slowing down the load is dissipated on electrical resistors.

We design powerful braking resistors for centrifuges, cranes and similar applications where DBRs are required.

Typical applications

  • Cranes
  • Centrifuges
  • Other applications where DBRs are required
